objective: Replace the three different 429 sentences (the composer, the reply box and the repost error, FRONTEND-026) with one short, calm line, "You’re going a bit fast. Wait a moment and try again.", exported once as RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE from a new shared module frontend/src/lib/messages.ts, which ComposePage, InlineComposer and PostAction import, so the three surfaces show the identical string.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: agent/FRONTEND-054 is cut from the tip of the integration branch outstanding-track-5 after the FRONTEND-053 budget fold (bundle-budgets/FRONTEND-053.ts is gone and BASE.lazy has "css:NotificationsPage.css": 368). It runs in parallel with FRONTEND-055, which writes none of this unit's paths.
Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation. The red reason is that frontend/src/lib/messages.ts does not exist, so the three test files below fail to import it.

New frontend/src/lib/messages.ts exports one constant, RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE, whose value is exactly "You’re going a bit fast. Wait a moment and try again." The apostrophe is U+2019 (’), as the UI's other contractions and possessives in frontend/src are written. It names no duration, no number, no status and no server detail. A doc comment says it is what every posting path shows on a 429 and why it is shared (one line in three places, FRONTEND-054).

ComposePage.tsx: the RATE_LIMITED constant is deleted and failureMessage returns RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE, imported from ../../lib/messages, for a PostNotCreated with status 429. InlineComposer.tsx: its 429 branch shows RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE, imported the same way. PostAction.tsx: a RepostRateLimited error shows RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE, imported the same way. Nothing else in the three files changes: the conditions that choose the message (status 429 on POST /posts; RepostRateLimited only for a repost's POST) are unchanged.

Every other failure message is unchanged, character for character: ComposePage's GENERIC_FAILURE and the six refusalMessage texts, InlineComposer's "We could not post your reply. It is still here — please try again.", and PostAction's "We could not save that just now. Please try again." A like, an unlike and an undone repost answered 429 keep the generic toggle failure.

New test frontend/src/lib/messages.test.ts: (a) RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE equals the exact string above, U+2019 included; (b) read from disk, ComposePage.tsx, InlineComposer.tsx and PostAction.tsx each import RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE from "../../lib/messages"; (c) no non-test source file (.ts or .tsx, not *.test.*) under frontend/src/features/compose/ or frontend/src/features/feed/, with its comments removed, matches /too quickly|wait a little|going a bit fast|slow down/i, so the line lives only in lib/messages.ts and neither feature keeps a second 429 sentence; (d) a guard that the sweep in (c) read at least ComposePage.tsx, InlineComposer.tsx and PostAction.tsx, so it cannot pass on an empty walk. Comments are removed before (c) because features/feed/api.ts's RepostRateLimited doc comment says "posting too quickly" and is a comment, not UI text; it stays as it is.

Existing tests this unit changes (a behaviour change, so named here), and only these: frontend/src/features/compose/rate-limit.test.tsx deletes its COMPOSE_RATE_LIMITED and REPLY_RATE_LIMITED constants and asserts RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE, imported from ../../lib/messages, wherever it asserted either; frontend/src/features/feed/repost-rate-limit.test.tsx deletes REPOST_RATE_LIMITED and asserts RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE the same way. In both, the header comment's "The wording is asserted exactly, so changing it is a deliberate edit here" becomes that the wording is the shared RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE, pinned exactly in src/lib/messages.test.ts (FRONTEND-054). Every other assertion and case in both files (the three 429 bodies, no detail, no digit, no duration, the kept draft and reply, the rollback, the plain-repost path, the cleared message, the generic failures, setReposted's error) is untouched. So the composer, the reply box and the repost error are each pinned to the one imported string.

Bundle: no bundle-budgets file. The Director's prototype measured, with this test's build against the folded BASE, the entry JS 147,247 B gzip (-5) and 465,660 B raw (-80), the entry CSS unchanged, and ComposePage 3,907 to 3,888 B gzip (-19); every other output within 5 B. All inside the 100 B tolerance, so nothing is declared. If the finished implementation moves any output past the tolerance, or adds or removes one, stop and report. bundle-budget.ts is not touched and no budget is loosened.

Proof: npm run lint reports 0 problems; npm run typecheck and npm run build are green; the suite runs in the foreground, alone, sharded (npx vitest run --shard=N/3 --maxWorkers=2), and the PR records the shard counts and the measured bundle numbers.

No new dependency; no change outside the allowed paths; features/compose and features/feed still import no other feature (the connection rule, and compose's and feed's isolation tests stay green). src/lib/ is where both already share mediaUrl.ts.

Module docs: wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08c-frontend-compose.md's FRONTEND-026 bullet ("A 429 says to slow down, on the three posting paths only") adds that since FRONTEND-054 the three paths show one line, RATE_LIMITED_MESSAGE from src/lib/messages.ts, and quotes it; wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md's src/lib/ row adds messages.ts (the one 429 line the composer, the reply box and the repost error share, FRONTEND-054, → [[0x08c-frontend-compose]]).
